candidates.change_summary: Return the ERC-1967 admin slot constant instead of the implementation slot constant.
Return the ERC-1967 beacon slot constant instead of the implementation slot constant.
Return bytes32(0) instead of the implementation slot constant.
Delete the __Access_init(_accessControl) call so the access control address is never set and stays address(0), making all access-checked calls revert afterwards.
Pass address(0) as the access control address instead of the supplied _accessControl argument, so checkAccess always queries the zero address and access-controlled calls behave differently.
Flip the isTopLevelCall computation from !$._initializing to $._initializing so a top-level initialize() call always reverts with InvalidInitialization.
Set $._initialized = 0 instead of 1 so initialize() remains callable again after completion, allowing repeated re-initialization that changes stored state and emits Initialized again.
Delete the `emit Initialized(1);` statement so the externally observable Initialized event is no longer emitted after a successful initialize() call.
